verdict.rationale: GitHub docs explicitly show 'ollama run' used to chat with a model (e.g. 'Run and chat with Gemma 4'), and community benchmarks confirm real-world use of 'ollama run <model> --verbose' for interactive terminal sessions, corroborating the core CLI chat workflow. Missing for 10: a dedicated first-party tutorial on the interactive REPL commands (e.g. /bye, /set) and independent UX review specifically of the chat session experience.
